rationale: The Evaluator feedback recommends testing a slightly lower base_speed (1.35 or 1.4) to improve stability and reduce line loss events, increasing kd to 3 to enhance damping of oscillations, and adjusting sensor_weights to reduce the magnitude on the outer sensors to [-1.2, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.2]. I have implemented these changes to the controller to address potential oversteering and oscillations while aiming for better line tracking and fewer line loss events. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to evaluate the impact of these adjustments on stability and performance.
